svg.title: PLAY-05 — Sudden-death rising water
svg.desc: 1280 by 900 undivided shared arena with two remaining players, raised water and a submerged player's air indicator. The water surface reduces the remaining safe space without a sudden-death banner, new action or another camera region. The dashed wave outline is a monochrome structural convention, not production water styling.

g.text: ANNOTATIONS — not UI. Dashed boundary: raised translucent water. Bruno is submerged; the nearby bar shows remaining air.
Water rises in the existing timed discrete steps; safe space shrinks. All remaining players stay visible in the shared level.
No sudden-death banner, stop/reversal control or textual hazard cue is added. Standard HUD and player controls remain available.
Water appearance, air/life rules and Quick Liquid timing remain in the owning contracts. A still does not specify animation speed.
